constants.tool_description: List what is saved for one login place: the username (plain text, from the owner's own words) and the names of its sealed entries (the password, security answers). Never a value. Pass the login page's address or origin (https://…), or app:<bundle id>. Call it on a login page before asking the owner; fill a listed entry with browser_secret or mac_secret secret=<name>. `linked` lists the other login places that serve this site (a sign-in form on another address, or the site the owner typed for this task), each by the place its entries fill.
